t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. N two k gaal—o n Yêdu—k fî n tag’n k ban’a k biɛ gi pug’a. N two, yog mba k be nɛ’ k n k mɔk siɛla paŋ ama fî pa lkul’ k n be talat niŋ ama k ŋalmaam kultie a yal. Yêdu k be k kât a po, fî ywa mba tie tot-daâ yubɔn niŋ. Fî tie ywa mba tun k pag u kwa.
